scope: Offline demo only; no canonical source, release, backend or device changes
guardrailStatement: All RussiCaptor Runtime Regression Guardrails, including Laboratory Regression Guardrails LAB-G01 through LAB-G46, are mandatory acceptance gates for this work package. No guardrail is weakened, bypassed, deleted or threshold-relaxed.
productionAuthority: All canonical authority, reader, ownership, terminal and writer-fence contracts remain unchanged; this local capability grants no production role
generator: Unmodified generateNarvaLabPhysiology, dynamic values selected from ASTRUP/HEMATOLOGY/CLINICAL_CHEMISTRY
catalogSelector: NARVA_POLYTRAUMA is a pure generator/catalog input, not a demo exercise package identity or production authorization
source: Actual demo VitalSignEngine readings and HemorrhagePatientProcess clinical state frozen at order/collection time; generator's existing limited adult-trauma assumptions remain synthetic
orchestration: Demo-only adapter. Production LaboratoryWorkflowRuntime is not imported because stableJson reaches runtime diagnostic tracing
repeatPolicy: One panel per patient per session; UI explicitly says repeats are unavailable; stable semantic command IDs suppress duplicate gestures
limits: No separate physical specimen collection action
No lab order when fewer than 30 seconds remain before the existing 15 minute demo limit

persistence.migration: Add empty laboratory state to a valid v2 session on load. Preserve patient engines, clock, IDs, generation and ledger. Do not rewrite the old row just for loading; next supported local save writes v3 atomically
persistence.integrity: Deterministically replay real patient engines, command ledger and laboratory release boundaries; require identical persisted samples, groups, results and laboratory events
persistence.incompatible: RECOVERY_REQUIRED, explicit demo-only reset; no silent fabricated session
persistence.downgrade: Old schema-2 demo cannot consume v3. Do not downgrade/uninstall/clear-data; next APK must have a higher versionCode

timeDisplay.demoCorrection: DemoVitalsCard uses formatDemoDuration(patient.vitals.timestamp), preserving numerical measurements and engine time
timeDisplay.canonicalImpact: Shared canonical VitalsTab remains byte-for-byte unchanged and still prints raw fractional exerciseMinute
separateCanonicalPlan: Convert exerciseMinute to seconds only at presentation

Cover measurement card, history and canonical time subtitles
Run canonical regressions and separately scoped physical acceptance
